text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is seeking authority to prohibit vehicles greater than 2.0 metres in width from travelling on Barbara Godard Lane. Prohibiting vehicles over 2.0 metres in width from travelling the subject lane would be beneficial in reducing the incidence of damage to the adjacent private property.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited vehicles over 2.0 metres in width from travelling on Barbara Godard Lane.
